$schema: Capability graph for hal-plus scenario generation. See LLM_HALPLUS_V2.md §10.2.

capabilities.label: Terraform Enterprise
capabilities.provides: A self-hosted Terraform Enterprise runtime (org/project/workspaces, remote runs).

observable.what: The TFE web UI is reachable and the bootstrap org/project exist.

capabilities.notes: Primary target = container hal-tfe at https://tfe.localhost:8443, org hal, project Dave.

capabilities.label: GitLab CE (lab VCS host)
capabilities.provides: A local GitLab CE instance hosting the demo repo that TFE links to via VCS.

observable.what: The GitLab project (root/tfe-agent-demo) is reachable with main.tf + .gitlab-ci.yml seeded.

capabilities.notes: Bootstrapped as a side effect of the vcs-workflow command; not a standalone hal product. GitLab CE 18.10.1 at http://127.0.0.1:8080, login root / hal9000FTW.

capabilities.label: Terraform VCS-driven workflow
capabilities.provides: VCS-driven auto-apply of Terraform runs: a commit to the GitLab repo triggers a TFE run.
capabilities.manualTrigger: Push a commit to the main branch of the GitLab repo (root/tfe-agent-demo).

observable.what: GitLab fires a webhook to TFE, which queues and auto-applies a run; the latest run appears at the top of the workspace runs page.

capabilities.notes: Workspace auto-apply + execution-mode remote + queue-all-runs + vcs-repo linked on branch main. Twin target uses -bis names. See LLM_HALPLUS_V2.md §9.

capabilities.label: Terraform API/CLI-driven workflow
capabilities.provides: An ephemeral TFX API helper shell to drive TFE runs via the API/CLI instead of a VCS repo.
capabilities.manualTrigger: From the helper shell, drive workspaces and queue runs with tfx / the TFE API.

observable.what: Runs appear in the TFE workspace, queued via the API/CLI rather than a VCS webhook.

capabilities.notes: Builds/runs the ephemeral helper container hal-tfe-api (image hal-tfe-api:latest, base ghcr.io/straubt1/tfx:latest) and drops into a shell. Alias: api. statusTool shares its handler with get_tfe_cli_status and returns TEXT status (no structured payload) -> observable.linkFrom is null; the tfe.* dotted paths in access come from the dependsOn tfe node's get_tfe_status.

capabilities.label: HashiCorp Vault
capabilities.provides: A running Vault instance (secrets engines, auth methods, policies).

observable.what: The Vault API is reachable and unsealed.

capabilities.notes: Container hal-vault; root token surfaced by the CLI. statusTool returns TEXT status (not a structured payload), so no dotted-path linkFrom.

capabilities.label: Vault dynamic database credentials
capabilities.provides: On-demand, short-lived database credentials minted by Vault (no static DB passwords).
capabilities.manualTrigger: Request a credential: vault read database/creds/dba-role

observable.what: Vault mints a just-in-time MariaDB username/password with a 2m default TTL (max 2h) that auto-revokes when the lease expires.

capabilities.notes: MariaDB container hal-vault-mariadb at mariadb.localhost:3306. Vault mounts database/ (mysql-database-plugin), rotates the vaultadmin root password, role dba-role default_ttl 2m / max_ttl 2h, revocation DROP USER. statusTool returns TEXT status (no structured payload).
